name: Incompatible Antipodal Maximum Halves
definition: Take $A=\{000,100,010,001\}$, the rank-one maximum three-leaf star, and join it on a new coordinate to the bitwise complement $\bar A$ in the opposite shore.
properties: The two maximum halves form two disconnected three-leaf stars because $A\cap\bar A=\varnothing$. Conditioning the first old coordinate to zero gives $\{000,100,010,111\}$, which shatters its first two coordinates but contains no square. Hence the antipodal double is not conditioning-minimal non-ample: a proper conditioning is already non-ample.
